generate_gmock_class: generate Google Mock classes from a C++ header file with specified class names
build_mock_methods: build mock method definitions from virtual functions in a C++ class
parse_cpp_ast: parse a C++ source file into an abstract syntax tree for code analysis
generate_mock_namespace: generate mock class code wrapped in the correct C++ namespace blocks
run_gmock_generator: run the gmock_class.py script to output Google Mock code to stdout
